intro: Every word this module's exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 304 cards, 109 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is work, study, media and opinions, and the verbs and connectors you need to argue a point, from the themes Technik & Medien, Gesundheit & Ernährung, Umwelt, Politik & Gesellschaft. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Nouns come with their plural
tips[0].text: By now the plural matters as much as the article, because you write longer texts. Read the plural on the back of every noun card, and notice the pattern it follows.
tips[0].check.why: The plural note -e tells you to add -e: zwei Bildschirme.
tips[1].title: Tech verbs are mostly separable
tips[1].text: einschalten, ausschalten, herunterladen, hochladen: in a main clause the prefix goes to the end. speichern and drucken stay in one piece.
tips[1].check.why: hochladen is separable: lade at position 2, hoch at the end.
tips[2].title: Strong past forms: learn the triple
tips[2].text: gehen – ging – gegangen, kommen – kam – gekommen, sehen – sah – gesehen. Say the three forms as one chant; the middle one is the storytelling past.
tips[2].check.why: trinken – trank – getrunken: the vowel family i – a – u.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "speichern".
hook: Technology, health, the environment and society: the words you need to argue a point, each noun with its article and plural.
